items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 3:44 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic noted the Council meeting on Monday March 2, 2026 will commence at 4:00 p.m. rather than 7:00 p.m., which will then be followed by a Special Council/Caucus meeting if required.
